box.highlights: Connetquot 21, Smithtown West 14: Nick LaMantia had 11 receptions for 157 yards and two touchdowns for Connetquot (1-0) in Suffolk II. His first 1-yard touchdown in the second quarter put Connetquot ahead 12-7. His 83-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter, proved to be the game-winner. Michael Ross completed 27 passes for 343 yards and three touchdowns. Devin Shapiro had five receptions for 53 yards and a touchdown. He also had two interceptions on defense. Matt Gomez had two sacks, two tackles for loss, and a forced fumble.

North Babylon 30 , Connetquot 29 : Daivon Lofton had 38 carries for 242 yards and four touchdowns to lead North Babylon (1-1) in Suffolk II.  Lofton scored on runs of 2, 11, 5 and 2 yards.  North Babylon had a 10-play 56 yard drive late in the fourth quarter which took six minutes off the clock.  First year coach John Rowland earned his first varsity win.

Half Hollow Hills East 48, Connetquot 20: Dakim Griffin had 19 carries for 201 yards and five touchdowns to lead Half Hollow Hills East (2-1) in Suffolk II. His longest touchdown run, which went for 70 yards, extended the lead to 29-14 in the second quarter. Jacob Robinson completed 8 of 12 passes for 200 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in the win. Louis Mathurian had five receptions for 130 yards and a touchdown and had seven tackles.

Connetquot 29, West Babylon 26: Tyler McCarthy's three-yard touchdown run with one minute left in the game capped an eight-play, 70-yard drive and gave Connetquot a 27-24 lead in Suffolk Division II Friday night. Michael Ross' two-point conversion pass to Tommy Malvagno extended the lead to 29-24. Brian Marra intercepted a West Babylon Hail Mary at the 1-yard line with one second left in the game to ice the win. Ross threw for 278 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions on 26-of-34 passing. He also threw two two-point conversion passes. Nick LaMantia made seven receptions for 130 yards and a touchdown. Devin Shapiro made nine receptions for 81 yards and a touchdown and had an interception on defense. Billy Walker had three sacks, including a key one on the final West Babylon drive. Stephen Bubier made 12 tackles, including one for a loss and a sack and Matt Gomez made nine tackles, including three for a loss for Connetquot (2-2). West Babylon is 2-2.

Connetquot 42, Smithtown East 32: Michael Ross completed 18-of-29 passes for 274 yards and a touchdown and Nick LaMantia rushed for 42 yards and two touchdowns on seven carries to lead Conentquot (3-2) in Suffolk II. Shaun Hill rushed for 72 yards and two touchdowns on 16 carries and Ross rushed for 24 yards and a touchdown on four carries. John Feramola led the defense with 13 tackles, six tackles for loss and Giovanni DeRenzo had 12 tackles, three tackles for a loss. Smithtown East is now 1-4.

Bellport 42, Connetquot 0: Donte Phillips rushed for 96 yards and three scores on 15 carries and Jack Halpin rushed for 98 yards and two scores on eight carries to lead Bellport (5-1) in Suffolk II. Halpin also completed 5 of 7 passes for 120 yards and Phillips made three catches for 70 yards. Calvin Pedatella and Marc Promutico led the defense with eight tackles apiece.

Newfield 35, Connetquot 34: Newfield scored two touchdowns with under six minutes left in the game to notch the come-from-behind win in Suffolk II Friday night. James Hannon's 10-yard touchdown pass to Dylan Smith on fourth down, followed by a Jadon Forthe extra point, with under a minute left provided the final margin. Hannon threw for 120 yards on 10-of-13 passing, ran for 66 yards, and threw for and ran for a touchdown.  Joe Hackal rushed for 192 yards, caught five passes for 71 yards, had an interception, and rushed for two touchdowns for Newfield (5-2). Connetquot is 3-4.

Connetquot 47, Copiague 0: Michael Ross threw for 182 yards and four touchdowns on 13-of-14 passing in Suffolk II Friday night. Nick LaMantia caught four passes for 66 yards and three touchdowns. His touchdowns came from 40, 15, and 1 yards. Nick Pepitone scored a 93-yard rushing touchdown in the third quarter. Connetquot scored 26 points in the first quarter, including three of Ross' touchdown passes and a three-yard rushing touchdown from Shaun Hill. Christian Parades made eight tackles and had a sack. Billy Walker also had a sack. John Feramola forced two fumbles and Stephen Bubier recovered two for Connetquot (4-4). Copiague is 0-8.

Lindenhurst 35, Connetquot 13: Jake Trovato had 191 yards and three touchdowns to lead No. 1 Lindenhurst over No. 8 Connetquot in the Suffolk II quarterfinals. Trovato scored two touchdowns in the third quarter, one on a 46-yard run and the other on an 18-yard run to give the Bulldogs a 21-13 lead. Dom Artale had 74 yards on five carries. Orrik Blaise had 54 yards and a touchdown on the ground. The Bulldogs rushed for 343 yards and scored 28 unanswered points. Joe DeGregorio led the defense with 12 tackles and a sack. Chris Carson had 10 tackles and an interception. Lindenhurst (8-1) will host a semi-final game at 7 p.m. on Friday, November 12th. Connetquot finishes 4-5.
